what: On hover the link text rolls up by one line height and out, and the same text hidden below (tint type uses the accent color) rises in over .5s — on release it returns in .3s (curve cubic-bezier(.4,.4,0,1)). With line on, a 1px underline is laid in two layers of halves: on hover the front layer retracts to both ends in .3s, splitting from the center, and the back layer vanishes at once. On release the back layer fills from the center to both sides and the front layer from both ends to the center, together in .3s, joining up

options.in: Duration of the roll when raising (s), default .5
options.look: tint: Rising characters take the accent color (leaving characters also tint to the accent as they exit — ‹…See more› link)
options.look: next: Only the incoming letters take the accent color, outgoing letters keep their own color (Brand header menu)
options.--fx-weight · --fx-gap: Underline thickness · gap from text (via style), default 1px · 4px
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Sphere label (child) — if none, nothing is attached
